readme.what: Daily history of one F&O underlying from the official NSE UDiFF F&O bhavcopy. Column format: every key listed in cols is an array parallel to days (oldest first). null = not available that day (e.g. untraded contract has no candle). Days on which the underlying has no contracts are absent.
readme.spot: underlying price in the bhavcopy (index level / stock cash price)
readme.o,h,l,c: near-month futures open, high, low, close (c = settlement-based close price of the file). The near-month contract rolls to the next expiry on the expiry day itself. o/h/l are null when the contract did not trade that day or the candle was inconsistent
readme.fx: expiry (YYYYMMDD) of the near-month futures contract used for o,h,l,c,v
readme.oi: total futures open interest, all expiries (units)
readme.doi: change in total futures open interest vs previous day, all expiries (units)
readme.coi: total call open interest, all expiries (units)
readme.poi: total put open interest, all expiries (units)
readme.pcr: put OI / call OI over all expiries (3 decimals)
readme.pcrn: put OI / call OI of the nearest option expiry
readme.nx: nearest option expiry (YYYYMMDD) used for pcrn, mp, hc, hp (an expiry on the trade date counts as over, same rule as the futures roll)
readme.mp: max pain strike of the nearest option expiry (strike with the lowest total payout to option writers; lowest strike wins a tie)
readme.hc,hp: strike with the highest call OI / highest put OI in the nearest option expiry
readme.roll: dates (YYYYMMDD) on which the near-month futures contract differs from the previous day in this file
readme.u: last data date in this file (YYYYMMDD)
readme.units: OI and volume in units (quantity), not lots
